unbuilt_not_locked.note: Sorry-bearing companion. Stronger F1 fold/trace lemmas and extra F11/F12/F18/F19 names live here and are not lake-build locked.

lambda.public_wording: Lambda uniqueness is Conjecture 1. Unconditional uniqueness under bare A1-A5 is machine-checked false. Conditional uniqueness is experimental, outside the locked eight.

khipu_distinctions.f4_proves: Acyclicity of a Nat-indexed edge list under the backward-edge invariant dst < src, including append of a fresh max node.
f4_does_not_prove: single-valued-vote agreement of a deployed consensus runtime
khipu_distinctions.f7_proves: Drain of an in-memory list queue equals the enqueued send order.

claims.name: Replay-Hash Determinism
claims.exact_mathematical_statement: For any f : α → β and x : α, f x = f x; and xs.map f = xs.map f.
claims.supported_input_domain: Any Lean function application and list map. No runtime hash, log, or storage domain.
claims.refinement_gap: The compiled locked theorems are reflexive equality. They do not prove hash stability of a recorded log, persistence, or a production replay engine. Stronger fold/trace lemmas in unbuilt PuriqFormulaLean.lean are not locked.
claims.public_wording: Locked F1 is reflexive equality of a pure application and of List.map. It is not a production replay-hash proof.

claims.name: Khipu DAG acyclicity under backward edges
claims.exact_mathematical_statement: If every edge (src, dst) satisfies dst < src, reachability strictly decreases the node index, so no node reaches itself; appending edges from a fresh max node k to targets < k preserves the invariant and acyclicity.
hypotheses: new edges have source k and target < k
claims.supported_input_domain: Finite lists of Nat×Nat edges obeying dst < src. Nodes are natural numbers, not runtime organ identities.
claims.refinement_gap: Does not prove acyclicity of a store that admits forward edges, concurrent writers, or Byzantine voters. Does not prove Khipu BFT.

counterexamples.shows: a two-cycle (0,1),(1,0) is possible without the invariant

claims.public_wording: Locked F4 proves acyclicity for the encoded backward-edge Nat DAG, including append of a fresh max node.

claims.name: Chaski FIFO reception order
claims.exact_mathematical_statement: chaskiDrain (chaskiEnqueueAll [] msgs) = msgs, and the i-th drained element equals msgs[i]?.
claims.supported_input_domain: In-memory finite lists of Nat message ids. No network, disk, or retry semantics.
claims.refinement_gap: Does not prove FIFO under retries, deduplication, persistence, or recovery. drain is definitionally the list itself.

counterexamples.shows: drain yields [10, 10]; exactly-once is not proved

claims.public_wording: Locked F7 proves send-order equals drain-order for the encoded list queue.

claims.name: Ayni reciprocity conservation
claims.exact_mathematical_statement: For b c : Int, (b + c) - c = b.
claims.supported_input_domain: Lean integers. Not an economic, social, or ledger runtime.
claims.refinement_gap: Integer add-then-subtract cancellation. Does not prove conservation of a deployed event log or tit-for-tat strategy.
claims.public_wording: Locked F11 is the integer identity (b + c) - c = b.

claims.name: Kuramoto additive fragment
claims.exact_mathematical_statement: For p1 p2 k : Nat, k * (p1 + p2) = k * p1 + k * p2.
claims.refinement_gap: Left distributivity only. Not nonlinear Kuramoto synchronization.
claims.public_wording: Locked F12 is Nat left distributivity, an additive fragment only.

claims.name: Reed-Solomon RS(10,6) parity arithmetic
claims.supported_input_domain: Natural-number shard counts with total=10 and data=6.
claims.refinement_gap: Parity-count arithmetic. Not an encoder, decoder, MDS proof, or erasure-recovery implementation.

counterexamples.shows: hypothesis e ≤ 4 fails; the locked lemma does not apply

claims.public_wording: Locked F18 is 10 - 6 = 4 and the inequality 6 ≤ 10 - e when e ≤ 4. It is not a Reed-Solomon codec.

claims.name: Bekenstein additive scaffolding
claims.exact_mathematical_statement: For s1 s2 : Nat, s1 ≤ s1 + s2; equivalently s ≤ s + d.
claims.refinement_gap: Monotone Nat addition. Not the physical Bekenstein bound S ≤ 2πkRE/(ℏc).
claims.public_wording: Locked F19 is Nat add-right monotonicity, an additive fragment only.

claims.name: Khipu emit append-only monotonicity
claims.exact_mathematical_statement: seqLog n = List.range n; seqLog (n+1) = seqLog n ++ [n]; members of seqLog n are < n; and for i < j < n, (seqLog n)[i] < (seqLog n)[j].
claims.supported_input_domain: Natural-number prefixes of List.range. Not an external clock, database sequence, or distributed log.
claims.refinement_gap: Proves monotonicity of List.range indices. Does not prove monotonicity of a deployed emit path.
claims.public_wording: Locked F22 proves List.range sequence numbers strictly increase with position.
